structures.name: 闭环 Go-to-Market 模型
structures.subject: 企业如何将营销与销售整合为单一闭环系统

elements.name: 技术转变
elements.description: 共享客户数据基础和协调系统，使营销人员、销售人员和 AI 代理从相同上下文操作

evidence.quote: a shared customer data foundation and coordinated systems that allow marketers, sellers, and AI agents to operate from the same context

elements.name: 组织转变
elements.description: 共享激励和指标，衡量整个客户旅程的结果

evidence.quote: shared incentives and metrics that measure outcomes across the full customer journey

elements.name: 持续交互
elements.description: 交互变得持续而非碎片化，上下文向前传递

evidence.quote: Interactions become continuous rather than fragmented. Context carries forward instead of resetting at every stage

elements.name: 实时细分演化
elements.description: 细分实时演化，外展跨渠道协调

evidence.quote: segmentation evolves in real time, outreach is coordinated across channels
When these elements come together, the customer experience changes fundamentally
When these elements come together, the customer experience changes fundamentally
shared customer data foundation...segmentation evolves in real time

constraints.statement: 技术转变和组织转变必须同时成功

evidence.quote: Success requires two shifts

structures.name: AI 部署整合度演进路径
structures.subject: 企业从分散到整合的 AI 部署阶段

elements.name: 阶段1: 功能孤岛
elements.description: 分别在营销和销售中部署 AI，各自独立运行

evidence.quote: still approaching AI transformation function by function, embedding it separately within marketing and within sales

elements.name: 阶段2: 跨职能执行
elements.description: AI 执行开始跨越原本 distinct 的营销和销售活动

evidence.quote: execution increasingly spanning what were once distinct marketing and sales activities

elements.name: 阶段3: 闭环系统
elements.description: 营销和销售作为单一系统重新设计

evidence.quote: redesigning marketing and sales as a single system
still approaching AI transformation function by function...execution increasingly spanning
execution increasingly spanning...redesigning marketing and sales as a single system

constraints.statement: 阶段演进需要技术基础和组织变革

evidence.quote: Success requires two shifts

structures.name: 客户体验碎片化问题结构
structures.subject: 为什么分离的营销和销售系统导致客户体验问题

elements.name: 多渠道买家旅程
elements.description: 买家跨多个触点研究、评估和决策，不再线性

evidence.quote: Buying journeys no longer follow a linear path

elements.name: 分离的数据系统
elements.description: 营销和销售基于不同数据集和断开的系统操作

evidence.quote: When marketing and sales operate on separate data sets and disconnected systems

elements.name: 碎片化体验
elements.description: 客户体验被破坏，信息不一致

evidence.quote: the customer journey is broken and experience suffers

elements.name: 供应商切换
elements.description: 跨团队信息不一致是客户切换供应商的首要原因

evidence.quote: buyers cite inconsistent information across teams as the top reason for switching suppliers
Buying journeys no longer follow a linear path...When marketing and sales operate on separate data sets

constraints.statement: 碎片化问题在多渠道环境下被放大

evidence.quote: more than 80% of consumers use multiple channels...Omnichannel execution has become the minimum required

structures.name: AI SDR 角色转型结构
structures.subject: SDR 角色如何从销售职能演变为跨职能的 agentic 工作流

elements.name: 传统 SDR 角色
elements.description: SDR 传统上属于销售部门

evidence.quote: Traditionally, SDRs sit within sales

elements.name: Agentic SDR 角色
elements.description: 在 agentic 模型中，角色跨越营销和销售，结合需求生成、个性化和早期参与

evidence.quote: the role spans both marketing and sales, combining demand generation, personalization, and early-stage engagement into a single, continuous workflow

elements.name: 品牌标准和客户上下文
elements.description: 品牌标准和客户上下文随代理跨每一步传递

evidence.quote: Brand standards and customer context travel with the agent across every step
